property_summary: For every caller address, calling owned() must revert unless the caller equals C.owner() (i.e., onlyOwner enforces that non-owners cannot call owned()); the mutant removes the require so some non-owner caller will be able to call owned() (not revert) and thus break this invariant.
change_summary: Replace onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone by removing the require, so owned() can be called by non-owners and possibly change state if owned() mutates owner (observable difference).
